name: view
label: View
description: View of the table's configured layout to render

name: forcedViewName
label: Forced view
description: Specify overriding the view of this form

name: query
label: Encoded query
description: Encoded query string to preset fields

name: readOnlyForm
label: Read-only
description: Flag to make this form read only

name: inUiBuilder
label: In UI Builder
description: Flag indicating that this Form is composed inside a UI builder page

name: inPopover
label: In Popover
description: When defined, form is inside a now-popover content slot. Use its 'closed' property to indicate whether the popover is closed or opened. Form data will only be fetched when the popover is opened.

name: bare
label: Remove padding area
description: Remove the left padding on the form.

name: isShowLoader
label: Show loader on record changes
description: When form's target record changes, render now-loader until the request for the new target record data is completed

name: workspaceConfigId
label: Workspace ID
description: Sys ID for workspace configuration this form is in

name: displayMode
label: Display mode
description: Whether the component should display as a full fledged read-only form or a more condensed form with data defined in label-value pairs.

name: labelValueLayout
label: Label Value Layout
description: When display mode is 'label-value', this property determines the layout of the label-value pairs.

name: labelValueLayoutSize
label: Label Value Layout Size
description: When display mode is 'label-value', this property determines the size of labels and value texts.

name: isSectionTitleHidden
label: Hide all section titles
description: When true, all section titles are not displayed. If disable collapse is also true, the entire section header is not displayed

name: disableCollapse
label: Disable section collapsing
description: When true, user cannot collapse sections
